$description: Field (platform/components/Field), library wave 6, lane B: the tokens of its character counter. The rest of Field's tokens are in the shared set.

field-foot-gap.$description: Field counter: the gap between the description and the count on the help line.

field-counter-text.$description: Field counter: the count's color (the description's).

field-counter-font-family.$description: Field counter: the count is a technical value, in the data font.

field-counter-font-size.$description: Field counter: the count's size (the description's, so the two share a baseline).

field-counter-over-text.$description: Field counter: the count's color past the limit (the error's).
